newsitem.title: USA: Applied Magnetics touts Read-Rite proposal.
newsitem.headline: Applied Magnetics touts Read-Rite proposal.

text.p: Applied Magnetics Corp, defending its offer to acquire Read-Rite Corp in a stock swap valued at about $1.76 billion, said Friday it "would not structure or engage in a transaction that is dilutive to the interests of Applied Magnetics."

Applied Magnetics, in a press release, said it was issuing the statement "in response to questions from analysts and investors regarding the company's willingness to modify its proposal to acquire Read-Rite."
"Our intention is to form a business combination with Read-Rite that creates value for the shareholders of both companies," Chief Executive Craig Crisman said in the statement.
Applied Magnetics officials were not available for further comment.
The company made its offer for Read-Rite last month. Read-Rite has rejected the bid.
